PA2.note: thread-forming screw for plastics; terminal is a 1.6-1.7 mm pilot hole in plastic, no nut

sleeve.rule: every hole where a printed part is clamped under a screw head or nut carries one; holes a screw threads into carry none (owner 2026-11-18)
sleeve.head_bearing: the head (or washer) should bear on the sleeve's steel end: report the bearing ring width min(head r, sleeve outer r) - sleeve inner r (mm)
